Charcoal powder cleans pores and impurities without imitation and delivers sufficient moisture Chamos Agassi Tea Repair Silk Mask Pack. It nourishes the skin and makes it healthy.   • Charcoal Powder

It manages pores and impurities, and removes dead skin cells as well. Mineral ingredients contained in

charcoal help maintain healthy skin.

  • Aloe Vera Leaf Juice

The house obtained by squeezing the leaves of aloe vera improves the condition of the skin. It soothes sensitive skin caused by external stimuli and provides an effective moisturizing effect.

  • Trehalose

It binds with moisture itself to prevent moisture loss and helps to have a moisturizing function.

  • Copper Tripeptide-1

It strengthens the skin barrier and provides conditioning to help keep the skin vibrant and healthy.

  • Bambusa Vulgaris Extract

It helps to manage with moist skin with moisture. It provides a refreshing feeling to the skin and helps to clear dull skin.

WHAT ARE THE BENEFITS OF USING THIS PRODUCT

- Contains charcoal powder to remove impurities from the skin and pores Cleanly manages old dead skin cells.
- Black bamboo sheets containing charcoal not only purify the skin, but also purify the complexion of the skin.
- It contains a variety of plant extracts that are good for pore convergence and refines rough skin texture.

SUITABLE FOR

- Skin with poor oil-moisture balance, skin with large pores & Oily skin.
- Those who need complexion purification.
- People with severe skin stress due to frequent outdoor activities.

HOW TO USE

- It is recommended to tap 2-3 times before opening the pouch to mix the highly concentrated ingredients evenly.
- After cleansing your face, organize your skin texture with toner. After taking out the mask, spread it evenly over the entire face and adhere it.
- After 20-30 minutes, relax and remove the mask from your face.
- If the contents remain on the face after removing the mask, tap lightly to absorb completely.

9896166949048.title: CICA CENTELLA CALMING AMPOULE
9896166949048.description:
CICA CENTELLA CALMING AMPOULE - 50ML

WHAT IT IS

It is a double functional highly concentrated cica ampoule that contains 82% Korean centella asiatica extract that soothes skin from the outside pollution, protects and improves condition of damaged skin. help to whiten and improve wrinkles. It helps to reinforce skin barrier and maintains skin healthy.

WHAT IT CONTAINS

  • Centella Asiatica Extract

Centella asiatica extract improves damaged skin and helps to soothe and relieve skin fatigue.

  • Dipropylene Glycol

It maintains moisturizing effect by blocking moisture evaporation from skin. It offers Liveliness and vitality to skin and helps to maintain skin conditioning.

  • Beta Glucan

As a polymer ingredient that is consisted of several Beta-Glucans, It supplies moisture to skin deeply.

  • Laminaria Japonica Extract

It forms elastic and smooth transparent layers on the skin surface and also offers sfotness to skin.

WHAT ARE THE BENEFITS OF USING THIS PRODUCT

- Its suitable for Sensitive skin.
- It will Moisturize and Hydrate the skin.
- It will make skin Tighter and Plumped.
- It will prevent Wrinkles and make skin Brighter.
- It will treat Redness of skin and correct Skin tone.

SUITABLE FOR

- People with sensitive skin.
- People who have thin and always red skin.
- People who have tired and saggy skin.
- People who have skin that’s sensitive to changes in daily temperature.

HOW TO USE

- Wash and cleanse your face with a toner first.
- Take a suitable amount of oil in dropper and evenly spread over your face.
- Gently rub all over face with fingertips and let it absorb into skin

9896167080120.title: COLLAGEN REPAIR SILK MASK PACK
9896167080120.description:
COLLAGEN REPAIR SILK MASK PACK - 23ML

WHAT IT IS

It is a must mask pack to have for healthy skin. It supply collagen, elasticity and smoothness to the skin that reduces with the passing time. By using this mask pack daily you can achieve smooth, moist and healthy skin.

WHAT IT CONTAINS

  • Hydrolyzed Collagen

It has an excellent water-holding capacity, moisture absorption, and retention and anti-skin aging, and anti-melanogenic capacities. Improve skin hydration, wrinkling, and elasticity in women.

  • Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice

Aloe barbaensis leaf juice is a great moisturiser, anti-bacterial and many anti-inflammatory properties making it a potent ingredient for healing wounds, reducing any signs of sunburn and helping dehydrated skin to lock in moisture.

  • Shea Butter

Shea butter contains fatty acids. They lubricate the skin and create a barrier that keeps moisture in people with drier skin and maintain dewiness.

  • Jojoba Seed Oil

Jojoba Oil has anti-inflammatory properties which help to tame chaffing and chapping, reduce redness caused by drying and keep skin calm and comfortable. The Vitamin E and B-complex vitamins in the Jojoba Oil help in skin repair and damage control.

  • Natural Protector

Its a mixture of vegetable extracts of Soybean Ferment, Salix Alba Bark, Scutellaria Baicalensis Root. Chamaecyparis obtusa Leaf, Origanum Vulgare Leaf and Portulaca Oleracea that soothe skin, maisturize and control sebum.

WHAT ARE THE BENEFITS OF USING THIS PRODUCT

- It will Hydrate the skin.
- It will restore a Youthful appearance.
- Facial Rejuvenation can be achieved by using this product

SUITABLE FOR

- People with dry or dull skin.
- People with extreme dry skin after face wash People whose keratin frequently occurs.
- People who lose vitality.

HOW TO USE

- Wash and cleanse your face with a toner first.
- Take mask out of the sachet and apply on your face into the skin.
- Remove mask from face after 20-30 minutes and let absorb the remaining essence.

Accented with colorful tassels and paired with a printed dupatta echoing carpet-weave aesthetics, this design blends age-old craftsmanship with a statement of cultural elegance.

9896167211192.title: REPAIR CICA CENTELLA CREAM
9896167211192.description:
REPAIR CICA CENTELLA CREAM - 30g

WHAT IT IS

The highly concentrated CICA cream contains 60% Centella Asiatica Leaf Water, which is the key

Ingredient to soothes and protects skin from outside pollution. It takes care ofskin health and suitable for sensitive skin. It is a double functional cream that forms protective layers of moisture over sensitive/dry skin and helps to whiten and fights against wrinkles.

WHAT IT CONTAINS

  • Shea Butter

Shea butter contains fatty acids. They lubricate and create a barrier that keeps moisture in dry and rough skin. It also maintains dewiness in skin.

  • Ceramide NP

Ceramide NP can help improve the look and feel of dry or dehydrated skin. Ceramide NP has also been shown to reinforce skin's barrier strength to better resist external stressors.

  • Vegetable Squalane

Natural squalane has multiple benefits for the skin, including being an excellent moisturiser. Squalane helps restore the lipid barrier and protects the skin from dehydration.

  • Allantoin

Allantoin helps in shedding dead skin cells. It is a keratolytic agent, meaning it can soften and separate

out the comified (tough) layer of skin. It keeps the skin smooth by shedding off the dead skin.

  • Beta - Glucan

Beta-Glucans can help prevent cell damage and also help to soothe redness and imitation. It plumps. hydrate skin and helps to reduce fine lines and wrinkles.

WHAT ARE THE BENEFITS OF USING THIS PRODUCT

- It will treat Wrinkles and Fine lines.
- It Hydrates and Moisturize the skin.
- It makes skin Plumped, Glowing, and Glossy.
- It will Rejuvenate and make skin Youthful.

SUITABLE FOR

- People with rough, dehydrated, and dull skin.
- People who lost skin elasticity and saggy skin.
- People have irritated and wrinkled skin.

HOW TO USE

- Wash and cleanse your face with a toner first.
- Take a suitable amount of cream on your fingertips and evenly spread over your face.
- Gently rub cream over face with fingertips and let it absorb into skin.

9896167342264.title: SNAIL RADIANCE YOUTH OIL DROP 7 EMULSION
9896167342264.description:
SNAIL RADIANCE YOUTH OIL DROP 7 EMULSION - 50ML

WHAT IT IS

Snail Radiance Youth Oil is a product that forms a thin moisturizing oily layer over skin, prevents evaporation of moisture and offers moisture to dry skin. It's also a whitening, anti-wrinkle double functional emulsion that brightens dark or rough skin, helps to reduce, treat wrinkled and drooped skin.

WHAT IT CONTAINS

Snail Secretion Filtrate (15,000ppm)

Snail Secretion has many beneficial properties for the skin - it stimulates skin repair and healing while protecting the skin, has anti-ageing properties and promotes suppleness, moisture and the skin's radiance.

  • Hydrolyzed Collagen

Hydrolyzed collagen can help stop the clock and decrease the visibility of fine lines and wrinkles by supporting your skin's own natural collagen building. It assists structural bonds in the epidermis and collagen and elastin formation in the dermis.

  • Chamaecyparis obtusa Water

The phytoncide containing in hynoki cypress functions that increases immunity andterpene Ingredient

makes odor of the refreshing forest. It has excellent effect of purification of skin that removes harmful

materials against skin and adds vitality to skin as a natural plant.

  • Natural Protector

Its a mixture of vegetable extracts of Soybean Ferment, Salix Alba Bark, Scutellaria Baicalensis Root, Chamaecyparis obtusa Leaf, Origanum Vulgare Leaf and Portulaca Oleracea that soothe skin, moisturize and control sebum.

WHAT ARE THE BENEFITS OF USING THIS PRODUCT

- It will make skin Glowing and Glossy.
- It will Hydrate and Moisturize the skin.
- It will give a Radiant and Brightened skin.

SUITABLE FOR

- People with dry or dull skin.
- People who want lively and glossy skin.
- People who have dry skin causing severe tightness.
- People who need suppleness, moisture and radiance in their skin.

HOW TO USE

- Wash and cleanse your face with a toner first.
- Take a suitable amount of oil in dropper and evenly spread over your face.
- Gently rub all over face with fingertips and let it absorb into skin.

9896167309496.title: SNAIL REPAIR ANTI - WRINKLE CREAM
9896167309496.description:
SNAIL REPAIR ANTI - WRINKLE CREAM

WHAT IT IS

It improves skin health, fine wrinkles and offers neat texture to skin. It is an anti-wrinkle functional cream including snail secretion filtrate that takes care of dryness or dullness of skin, improves moist, wrinkles and elasticity of drooped skin.

WHAT IT CONTAINS

  • Snail Secretion Filtrate (300,000ppm)

Snail Secretion has many beneficial properties for the skin- it stimulates skin repair and healing while protecting the skin, has anti-ageing properties and promotes suppleness, moisture and the skin's radiance.

  • Various Vegetable Extracts

It’s a mixture of vegetable extracts of Soybean Ferment, Salix Alba Bark, Scutellaria Baicalensis Root, Chamaecyparis Obtusa Leaf, Origanum Vulgare Leaf and Portulaca Oleracea that soothe skin, moisturize and control sebum.

  • Sodium Hyaluronate

This reduces dryness and flaking by increasing skin hydration. Compared to high molecular weight HA, sodium hyaluronate can provide a greater hydrating effect.

  • Macadamia Seed Oil

Macadamia oil nourishes the skin and is great at moisturising. Containing high oleic, linoleic and palmitoleic acid, it’s been found beneficial in treating stretch marks, prevent chapping and reduce scars. It has also been known to help smooth and repair dry skin.

WHAT ARE THE BENEFITS OF USING THIS PRODUCT

- It will treat Wrinkles and Fine lines.
- It Hydrates and Moisturize the skin.
- It makes skin Plumped, Glowing and Glossy.
- It will Rejuvenate and make skin Youthful.

SUITABLE FOR

- People with rough, damaged and dull skin.
- People who lost skin gloss and its vitality.
- People who lost skin elasticity and saggy skin
- People having wrinkled skin

HOW TO USE

- Wash and cleanse your face with a toner first.
- Take a suitable amount of cream on your finger tips and evenly spread over your face.
- Gently rub cream over face with fingertips and let it absorb into skin.
- Can be used in Morning and Evening: Use before makeup in the morning and before sleep at night.

9896166981816.title: SNAIL REPAIR GOAT MILK MASK PACK
9896166981816.description:

WHAT IT IS

It is a double functional mask pack that contains horse fat and goat milk extract ingredients, supplies moisture and nutrition to dry skin, brightens dark and dull skin and helps to improve fine wrinkles. We recommend this mask pack to women with dry, dark or wrinkled skin.

WHAT IT CONTAINS

  • Goat Milk Extract

It works on skin conditioning and helps to take care of skin health and liveliness. It maintains skin moisture and prevents dryness.

  • Snail Secretion Filtrate

Using snail secretion extract from snail fed bio-light stone can get you excellent cosmetic composition in moisturizing skin.

  • Horse Fat

It helps to take care of skin elastic, glossy effect and repairs fine wrinkles on skin. It makes skin barrier strong

and reinforce moisturizing function.

  • Niacinamide/Adenosine

As a functional ingredient certified by the KFDA, it helps to whiten skin and treat wrinkles.

WHAT ARE THE BENEFITS OF USING THIS PRODUCT

- It will hydrate skin
- It will brighten skin, treat dullness and increase Skin Glow.
- It will treat Wrinkled and Saggy skin.
- It will promote skin Smoothness.

SUITABLE FOR

- People with dry skin
- People with wrinkled or drooped skin
- People who worry about dark/dull skin
- People who want to take care of skin smoothness

HOW TO USE

- Tap the sachet 2-3 times before applying so the highly concentrated ingredients will be mixed evenly in the sachet.
- After washing your face clean it with a toner.
- Take out sheet from the sachet and apply it on your face.
- Remove sheet after 30 minutes and let remaining essence absorb into the skin.

10656769114296.title: TOPFACE GLOSSPOP LIP BUTTER BALM
10656769114296.description: Lip Balm Gloss combines a natural glossy shine with a nourishing formula for everyday use. Enriched with Hyaluronic Acid, Shea Butter, natural oils, and peptides, it helps hydrate, soften, and protect lips from dryness. Its smooth silicone applicator ensures easy and even application, leaving lips comfortable, smooth, and glossy without a sticky feel.

10656768426168.title: TOPFACE PRO COMB & FILL BROW PEN
10656768426168.description: PRO Comb & Fill Brow Pen is a precision brow pen designed to create naturally fuller, well-defined eyebrows. Its comb-shaped tip creates fine, hair-like strokes to fill sparse areas and enhance brow shape. The highly pigmented, buildable formula provides up to 24-hour wear with a lightweight, smudge-resistant finish. Suitable for all skin types.

10656768491704.title: TOPFACE PRO INK FELT EYELINER
10656768491704.description: PRO Ink Felt Eyeliner is a high-performance eyeliner that delivers intense color and precise lines in a single stroke. Its fine felt tip allows easy and controlled application, from thin lines to defined wings. The highly pigmented, smudge-resistant and waterproof formula provides up to 24-hour wear without fading or running. Suitable for all eye shapes.

10656768590008.title: TOPFACE PRO MICRO PRECISION EYEBROW PENCIL
10656768590008.description: Micro Precision Eyebrow Pencil is a professional brow pencil designed to create precise, naturally fuller and well-defined eyebrows. Its fine retractable tip allows hair-like strokes and controlled application, while the built-in spoolie blends and shapes brows for an even finish. The long-lasting formula provides up to 18-hour wear without smudging or fading. Suitable for all skin types.

10656768786616.title: TOPFACE PROHD HYDRA GLOW EASY DROP FOUNDATION
10656768786616.description: PROHD Hydra Glow Easy Drop Foundation is a lightweight, buildable foundation designed to enhance the skin with a natural, healthy glow. Its creamy, second-skin texture provides medium coverage that blends seamlessly while helping smooth the appearance of imperfections. With long-lasting hydration and water- and sweat-resistant performance, it keeps skin fresh, comfortable, and radiant throughout the day. Suitable for all skin types, including dry, normal, mature, and sensitive skin.

9896167145656.title: VITA-BRIGHT REPAIR SILK MASK PACK
9896167145656.description:
VITA-BRIGHT REPAIR SILK MASK PACK - 23ML

WHAT IT IS

It is a mask pack that contains vitamins ingredients, puts liveliness into a dull or dark skin. This mask offers abundant moisture and nutrition to dry or rough skin. It takes care of smoothness of skin, relieves stress, soothes it and maintains skin health.

WHAT IT CONTAINS

  • Vitamin C E

Vitamin E ingredient is a moisturizing ingredient that prevents evaporation of skin moisture. It improves skin damage and prevents oxidation or spoilage of cosmetics.

A water-soluble vitamin, Vitamin C takes care of dull skin tone and clear the skin. It also improves the damage of skin and takes care of its health.

  • Centella Asiatica Extract

It prevents dryness of skin and helps to take care of its softness and smoothness. The Asiatic pennywort is excellent in soothing skin and suitable for sensitive skin.

  • Panthenol

As an ingredient extracting from Vitamin B5, it works as a lubricant to the skin surface and takes care of

its softness and smoothness.

WHAT ARE THE BENEFITS OF USING THIS PRODUCT

- It will Brighten; promote Skin Glow.
- It will Cure tiredness and fatigue of the skin.
- It will make skin Youthful and Plumped.

SUITABLE FOR

- People with dry or dull skin
- People who lost liveliness
- People who broke the balance between oil and moisture
- People who worry about rough skin
- People who take a lot of stress from the outside

HOW TO USE

- Tap the sachet 2-3 times before applying so the highly concentrated ingredients will be mixed evenly in the sachet.
- Wash and clean your face first.
- Take out the mask from the sachet and spread it over your face.
- Remove the mask after 20-30 minutes.
- Tap the remaining contents with your fingertips lightly over your face after removing the mask and let the contents absorb into skin.

9896167243960.title: VITA-C WHITENING PERFECT NIGHT CREAM
9896167243960.description:
VITA-C WHITENING PERFECT NIGHT CREAM - 50g

WHAT IT IS

Our Vitamin C Night Cream both protects and nourishes your skin while you sleep. Vitamin C rejuvenates skin, reducing signs of aging such as uneven tone, discoloration and fine lines and wrinkles, and promotes collagen health, brightening skin for a vibrant, youthful complexion.

WHAT IT CONTAINS

  • Vitamin E

Vitamin E is an important fat-soluble antioxidant and has been in use for more than 50 years in dermatology. It protects the skin from various deleterious effects due to solar radiation by acting as a free-radical scavenger.

  • Vitamin C

This incredible antioxidant, anti-inflammatory nutrient is known to improve skin tone and texture, hydrate the skin, and reduce signs of aging. Adding vitamin C to your skin care routine can not only brighten your complexion but also protect against skin damage caused by sun exposure and harmful free radicals.

Chamaecyparis Obtusa Water

With Chamaecyparis obtusa leaf extract, it can instantly plump and smooth your skin. Bamboo yam

fabric synthesized by the advanced nanotechnology allows small molecules to pass through more easily.

It can instantly hydrate your skin with rich element.

Aloe Vera Leaf Juice

Aloe Vera gel has cooling properties and is anti-inflammatory. Applying this gel helps with a protective layer for the skin, and it also helps to retain moisture. It is rich in antioxidants and minerals that boost the healing process.

WHAT ARE THE BENEFITS OF USING THIS PRODUCT

- It Hydrates, Brighten and give a Glowy skin appearance.
- It gives Even Tone skin and make skin more Youthful.
- It gives a Fresh, Healthy and Lively skin appearance.

SUITABLE FOR

- People with rough, damaged and dull skin.
- People who can not spend on expensive dermatologists and treatments.
- People who have fatigue and double skin tone.

HOW TO USE

- Wash and cleanse your face with a toner first.
- Take a suitable amount of cream on your finger tips and evenly spread over your face.
- Gently rub cream over face with fingertips and let it absorb into skin.
- Use 10 minutes before sleep.
